title: Pause when the game loses focus (alt-tab / phone backgrounded)
body: Retail checklist: a single-player match kept running when you switched apps. The pause menu now opens on application focus-out / pause (toggle in Settings -> Game).

title: VSync and frame-rate limit options
body: Retail checklist: Settings -> Video gains a VSync toggle and an FPS cap.

title: In-game credits / license attribution screen
body: Retail checklist: CC BY 4.0 attribution for the Soldat base content was only in CREDITS.md. The main menu now has a Credits & licenses screen.

title: Ask the player's name on first launch
body: Retail checklist: everyone played as 'Player' unless they found the Settings field. First launch now shows a skippable name prompt.
